Name: Balthazaar the Night Serpent, God of Chaos and Night

Voice: serpent, vile and cunning, cryptic, "The sssssun shall fall from the sssky, and into my gaping maw, DARKNESSSSS RISESSSSS!"

Description: gigantic celestial, 5 headed black serpent, eyes like the night sky, scales of gleaming crystalline onyx, vicious red fangs. He is a vicious and cunning master of evil, he desires to destroy all light in mortals hears and the world itself. He loves making deals, and is so immensely powerful he can give almost anything to those whom he can bind to his will, and once he has you in his grasp he squeezes until you die and then claims your soul for eternity.

Important Info: [[Gods of Terra-Nova]], rebelled and attempted to kill Illuman and devour the sun at the dawn of time, imprisoned in the Abyss. Patron of Damion Syrell, father of Drathara. Used [[Kairos]] to keep Pontius alive to make a perfect host for Arkonil but that plan failed. Currently chained at the bottom of creation in the Abyss.
